definition: The interdisciplinary field concerned with ensuring AI systems behave reliably, avoid unintended harmful behavior, and remain aligned with human values, especially as capabilities increase.
details: AI safety research spans technical work on alignment and robustness as well as broader questions about societal risks from increasingly capable AI systems, ranging from near-term harms to longer-term existential considerations.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. In plain words: The interdisciplinary field concerned with ensuring AI systems behave reliably, avoid unintended harmful behavior, and remain aligned with human values, especially as capabilities increase. Here is how it actually plays out: AI safety research spans technical work on alignment and robustness as well as broader questions about societal risks from increasingly capable AI systems, ranging from near-term harms to longer-term existential considerations. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is AI Safety.
